note: DFC family status is split per-member. Do NOT merge members into one number. Historical verdicts (DFC0/DFC1) preserved unchanged.

DFC1-R1 saved-T.detail: Backward-only saved-T fix; gradient-cosine gate PASS everywhere; 548x grad-error reduction at t=0 (0.4324 -> 0.00079 rel-L2); no-op at early-termination thresholds; no standalone speedup.

DFC1-R2 adaptive.detail: Per-pixel transmittance adaptive threshold (A/B/C + fixed sweep). >=1.2x E2E met only on sparsest room (1.206x, 4/8 cams); garden 1.140x, bicycle 1.061x FAIL (O(N) projection dominates dense-scene budget). No policy passes all 4 gates on all 3 scenes.

DFC2 universal fixed.detail: Generalization pack: 6 held-out Mip-NeRF360 scenes x 8 cams x {baseline, DFC@1e-7, DFC@1e-6}; NO per-scene threshold tuning (the scientific question). Assembler self-test PASSES (1e-7 generalizes at 0.03 dB / 0.40 reduction; 1e-6 fails at 0.08 dB). Awaiting isolated EPIC-05 A100 node.

DFC-FC0 convergence.detail: Full 30K training baseline vs DFC1-R2 (per-scene fixed thr room 1e-5, garden 1e-5, bicycle 1e-7). train_dfc.py is an UNVERIFIED scaffold; requires 200-iter smoke test on room before any 30K run; must run on an ISOLATED EPIC-05 A100 node.
